prompts.station:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG cutout fixture for a polished side-view railway videogame for a child under six. Primary request: one detailed standalone railway fixture. Style: semi-realistic colourful 3D storybook diorama, polished commercial videogame asset, charming and friendly without cartoon outlines, believable proportions, layered physical materials and realistic texture, sunlit soft rendering. Warm sunlight from upper left with gentle self-shadowing; transparent empty background, no background shadow plane. Broad horizontal landscape frame, entire object fits comfortably within frame with a slim transparent margin on every side. Avoid text, labels, logos, watermarks, characters, faces, engines, train cars, collage, frames, UI and surrounding landscape. Must have genuine alpha transparency behind object and in all open gaps, no checkerboard painted into image, no white background.
Subject and geometry: One British railway station building with a broad, long stone platform projecting across the whole asset width. Warm red brick building, realistic slate pitched roof, timber-framed glass windows, modest glass-and-metal platform canopy, wooden bench, clear doorway. Camera straight front-side orthographic view, horizontal platform upper surface near the lower quarter of the asset. Include enough exposed platform height for a moving train to sit in front. Entire building and both platform ends visible. No passengers, letters, signs, trains, tracks, rails or surroundings.
